title: E.l.f. Cosmetics partners with ZEPETO to launch first virtual styling experience
summary: Users of social media and metaverse platform ZEPETO can now access ‘Express your e.l.f.’ – a virtual styling experience for avatars – as the brand extends its commitment to meet its community in “unexpected places”

extraction.key_fact: 엘프 코스메틱스가 메타버스 플랫폼 제페토와 협력하여 가상 스타일링 체험 서비스를 선보인다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: E.l.f. Cosmetics partners with ZEPETO to launch first virtual styling experience
